requirements.text: Let a person inspect requirements and assumptions, revise a draft, and return the change to the agent's reasoning.
requirements.rationale: Validate whether direct manipulation makes consequential assumptions easier to notice than a chat-only exchange.

requirements.text: Do not change real owner-approved acceptance or approval records through this experience prototype.
requirements.rationale: The example is not business acceptance. Editing a draft does not grant authority to approve, merge or deploy.

assumptions.text: A structured review will reduce clarification rounds compared with a chat-only interaction.
assumptions.rationale: Unproved. Compare real review sessions before making a productivity claim.

assumptions.text: A successful local browser preview does not establish native VS Code MCP Apps compatibility.
assumptions.rationale: The renderer, discovery and permission path must be tested in the signed-in client separately.

components.name: MCP App view
components.responsibility: Inspect and edit a proposal; never decide business approval.

components.name: Target-bound MCP server
components.responsibility: Read the same model for chat and UI; validate draft-only, revision-checked writes.

components.name: Local example JSON model
components.responsibility: Persist the shared state. It is not a real acceptance or approval record.
